_comment: Sprint 2 (Switchboard Plan) — prebuilt vocab pack for medical.symptom_skin_concern (skin infection, worrying mole / cancer concern). Kept calm and clinical, not alarmist — this call carries real anxiety for whoever is rehearsing it. Authored directly, matches src/shared/contract.ts's VocabPack/GlossaryEntry shape.

entries.note: a natural, calm way to describe why a mole is concerning, without needing the word for cancer at all.
